notes: Prototype breadboard circuit built from the second (buzzer) image, which includes the RC circuit of the first image. The images show the breadboard in two orientations; the bottom-bank (f-j) naming from the second image is used.
LDR is a catalogue photoresistor; the 1µF capacitor is mapped to capacitor-10uf (POS/NEG) with value=1uF.
Pi pins read from the images: red wire = 3V3 (pin 1), green = GPIO4 (pin 7), black = GND (pin 6, GND.1); buzzer: black = GND (pin 9, GND.2), green = GPIO17 (pin 11). Exact GND.n numbering is assumed.
Buzzer port 1 is taken as the positive (red) leg at column 30 and port 2 as the negative (black) leg at column 28.
The LDR's second leg is placed in the same column as the capacitor's positive leg, per the tutorial text (the first image is ambiguous).

Laser pointer, drinking straw, tape, housing, the socket-pin test leads and the speaker alternative are not electrical parts of the breadboard circuit and are omitted. The final-assembly socket-socket jumper leads replace the breadboard and are not modelled.
